title: Zorvex supplementation and skeletal density in mice.
abstract: Bone loss is a major concern in ageing populations.
We fed adult mice a diet supplemented with zorvex for twelve weeks.
Zorvex supplementation significantly increased femoral bone density compared with controls.
The effect was dose dependent and was not observed in mice fed a standard diet.
No adverse effects on body weight were detected.

title: Glimmerine and arterial pressure in hypertensive adults.
abstract: Hypertension affects a large share of adults worldwide.
We conducted a randomised trial of glimmerine in 240 hypertensive adults.
Participants receiving glimmerine were followed for six months.
Glimmerine reduced systolic blood pressure by 12 mmHg relative to placebo.
Adverse events were mild and comparable between groups.

title: Quillon protein is required for cortical neuron survival.
abstract: Neuronal death underlies many neurodegenerative diseases.
Deletion of the quillon gene impaired survival of cortical neurons in culture.
Quillon-deficient neurons showed elevated apoptosis markers.
Re-expression of quillon rescued survival.

title: Vantrol and circulating cholesterol: a placebo-controlled trial.
abstract: Statins remain the mainstay of lipid-lowering therapy.
We tested vantrol, a novel compound, in 180 adults with high LDL cholesterol.
After twelve weeks vantrol did not lower LDL cholesterol compared with placebo.
HDL cholesterol and triglycerides were also unchanged.

title: Mindfulness meditation and stress hormones.
abstract: Chronic stress is associated with elevated cortisol.
Adults completed an eight-week mindfulness meditation programme.
Salivary cortisol decreased significantly after the meditation programme.
Self-reported stress fell in parallel.

title: Nalbrix vaccine efficacy in older adults.
abstract: Influenza causes severe illness in older adults.
In a large trial the nalbrix vaccine reduced laboratory-confirmed influenza infection by 60 percent in adults over 65.
Rates of autoimmune events did not differ between vaccinated and placebo groups.
Injection-site pain was the most common side effect.

title: Sleep duration and declarative memory consolidation.
abstract: Sleep supports the consolidation of newly learned material.
Volunteers who slept eight hours recalled more word pairs than those kept awake.
Slow-wave sleep duration correlated with recall performance.

title: Gut microbiome diversity and depressive symptoms.
abstract: The gut microbiome communicates with the brain through several pathways.
Lower microbial diversity was observed in patients with major depression.
Probiotic treatment produced modest improvements in mood scores.

title: Coral reef bleaching under marine heatwaves.
abstract: Marine heatwaves are increasing in frequency.
Coral bleaching intensity rose sharply when sea temperature exceeded the seasonal maximum by two degrees.
Recovery took several years at the monitored reef sites.

title: Deep learning for protein contact prediction.
abstract: Predicting residue contacts is a key step in structure prediction.
We trained a convolutional network on multiple sequence alignments.
The model outperformed earlier co-evolution methods on held-out families.
